DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

The arterial blood gas confirms respiratory acidosis and hypoxemia, while the chest radiograph showing fine reticular granularity and ground-glass appearance is the classic "ground glass" finding for alveolar collapse in a 33-week preterm infant. I have reached my limit of questions; the clinical picture and imaging findings are sufficient for this diagnosis.
